theorem: Automorphism order of the spread/double-six scheme
claim_boundary: finite automorphism-order theorem for the 36-object scheme; by the MCCCXCIV isomorphism the double-six scheme has the same order, but this does not choose a unique canonical spread-to-double-six labeling
reading: The 36-object spread/double-six scheme has automorphism order 51840. The first spread has a 36-element orbit and a 1440-element stabilizer, so orbit-stabilizer gives 36*1440=51840. This is exactly the E6/W33 symmetry scale already appearing throughout the bridge, now recovered from the spread/double-six association scheme itself.
